decision: Verified conditional aggregate descriptors; not city high-school observations
limitations: Highest completed level/grade is observed; current enrollment stage is inferred under progression restrictions. Boundary3_optional relaxes one such assumption, not all stage ambiguity.
Codes6(no travel),9 and blank retain full uncertainty; bins16/31 use conservative15/30 lower closures.
Expansion weights do not include sampling confidence intervals; ESTRATO/UPM clustered design must be respected in future variance analysis.
Residents in private households, not institutionalized population; school destination may be outside CDMX.
Only aggregate outputs are saved; person keys are used in memory for uniqueness, never published.
